You have to use fog of war to your advantage. You have to track their abilities that can cancel your snowball. You have to track their mobility that can dodge out of your snowball.

[2] A special hidden talent Noo-Noo has is that he is a champion that heavily punishes laners who either don't respect him or don't track him. His gank potential is absurdly easy and good. A gank is almost always guaranteed to work unless the laners know where he is.
[2] This also is an extremely early gank that I doubt the bot laners were going to see happen. They are literally level two. The reason it worked was the lack of respect.
[2] The first thing I changed was getting a ward down in his jungle to see how he was pathing. This can allow me to track where he is and warn my team about what side of the map he is on.
[2] In a 1v one against me, he will always lose.

[2] So, if you are up against a Noo-Noo, try to get a ward in his jungle so you know where he's pathing so you can match him. Another helpful tip is to try to invade more as his 1v one capabilities are incredibly low compared to a lot of other junglers.
